visual.detailed_description: Seven lettered parts: panel A is a block of eight green immunofluorescence images labelled Kappa, Lambda, IgG, IgA, IgM, C3, C1q and Fibrinogen; B, C and D are stained light microscopy views of glomeruli with 50 µm scale bars; E, F and G are grayscale electron micrographs with scale bars of 10, 5 and 2 µm.

panels.general_description: Eight green fluorescence images in two rows of four on dark backgrounds, labelled Kappa, Lambda, IgG, IgA, IgM, C3, C1q and Fibrinogen, showing bright green kidney glomeruli and tubule outlines.
panels.detailed_description: A block of eight fluorescence images separated by thin white lines, four across and two down. The labels printed in white at the upper right of each image read, top row left to right, Kappa, Lambda, IgG and IgA, and bottom row left to right, IgM, C3, C1q and Fibrinogen. All images show green fluorescence on a dark green-black background with rounded glomerular tufts and curved tubule outlines. Kappa, IgM and C1q show bright granular green in the glomerular tufts and along the tubule outlines; Lambda, IgG, IgA and C3 show fainter or patchier green in the tufts; the Fibrinogen image shows mostly diffuse green along tubule outlines with no clear bright tufts. Tiny, faint text at the upper left corner of the C3, C1q and Fibrinogen images is too small to read except for a lowercase word that looks like fibrinogen in the last. The panel letter A is printed in white in a black circle at the lower left.

visual.general_description: Dual-axis line chart of 24-hour urine protein and aPTT from 2012.04 to 2022.03 with treatment bands, bleeding events, CPM pulses, LA positivity and printed Factor II values.
visual.detailed_description: A line chart with a left axis titled 24-hr urine protein (mg/day) from 0 to 1,400 and a right axis titled aPTT (sec) from 0 to 160. The x axis has 18 rotated labels from 2012.04 to 2022.03: 2012.04, 2013.04, 2014.06, 2015.08, 2018.12, 2019.03, 2019.09, 2020.01, 2020.09, 2020.10, 2020.11, 2020.12, 2021.01, 2021.02, 2021.03, 2021.05, 2021.09 and 2022.03. An orange line with round markers starts low, peaks at about 1,200 at the 2019.03 label, dips, rises again near 2020.10 and falls toward 2022.03. A blue line with round markers varies between about 45 and 107 on the right axis, highest at the 2020.09 label. A pale lavender band across the top is labelled Steroid treatment and carries magenta triangles at six positions; a grey box labelled MMF + Tacrolimus spans from about the 2019.03 label to about the 2020.10 label; a green arrow labelled Cyclosporine treatment starts near the 2021.05 label and runs to the right end. Yellow down arrows along the bottom axis mark bleeding events at three positions, and six green down arrows mark CPM pulses. Red diamonds with printed numbers give Factor II values 44, 14, 17, 18, 22 and 23. The legend lists Bleeding event, CPM pulse, Factor II (%) and LA positive.
